note: Look recommender (R-4.6): the ONLY home of fit tables and look traits (look files carry none). Every number is a starting value, set by editorial judgement and reviewed; measured on real reels before it is called final. Score = 3 x fit[content type][look] + 2 x reference match + 1 x delivery fit - recent use (motion looks only). Editorial review 2026-10-17 (short-video editing coach): fast speech favours phrases over single Arabic words; bold opinion and comedy lead with phrases; emotional keeps still captions.

energy_from_cuts.note: client energy = clamp((median cuts per minute - floor) / span, 0, 1)

recent.note: motion looks only: sum over the client's last reels that used a motion look of weight x decay^age (age 0 = the most recent such reel; ordinary clips without one do not count)

variety.note: motion looks only: a look used in both of the client's last two reels gives way to the next-ranked look; below min_fit, no look

rate_bands.note: words per second, pauses over the caption catalog's pause_ignore_ms ignored (the same bands as caption auto)

motion.note: Motion looks (R-6.1, Phase 6): the catalogue is config/defaults/looks/motion/*.json (name, display, status planned | preview_gate | accepted); their traits and fit rows go here when each look is built.
